hero.name: Raybel Hernández
hero.title: Senior Software Engineer
hero.subtitle: Full-stack product engineer with end-to-end ownership — from an initial direction to a shipped product.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Senior Software Engineer
about.description1: Senior software engineer with 6+ years across web and mobile — a full-stack, product-minded builder with end-to-end ownership. Give me an initial direction and the authority to run with it, and I define the scope, decide the architecture, and implement changes on the fly, all the way to a shipped product. I work the whole stack: React/Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend; Node.js/NestJS, ASP.NET Core and PostgreSQL on the backend; cross-platform mobile with Flutter; and AI-powered features (LLMs, embeddings, vector search) on cloud infra like Supabase, Firebase, GCP and Cloudflare Workers.
about.description2: I've owned products end to end — from SnapnFund and All in Biking to Mergejob, an AI-powered job board that scores listings by semantic fit using embeddings and pgvector. Along the way I've designed database schemas and secure APIs, integrated Stripe and Google Cloud, and shipped scalable systems with smooth UX. I bring that same speed and precision to both code and collaboration.

wetrust.title: WeTrust
wetrust.description: A bilingual (English/Spanish) AI voice receptionist for local businesses that answers every inbound call, books, reschedules and cancels appointments straight into the business's real calendar, and hands off to a human the moment it matters. I designed and built the multi-tenant platform end to end: a Retell conversation-flow voice agent generated from each business's configuration, a Fastify/TypeScript backend with a range-based scheduling engine and calendar adapters (Google, Microsoft, native), a Next.js self-service client portal and internal console, and Twilio telephony with A2P 10DLC SMS confirmations and reminders across the whole appointment lifecycle. Rounded out with prepaid Stripe billing and a verification methodology of byte-for-byte flow-parity tests and live-call checks.

mergejob.title: Mergejob
mergejob.description: An AI-powered job board that scores every listing by semantic fit with a candidate's CV instead of by recency. I designed and built the platform end to end on a distributed architecture — Next.js on the frontend, Supabase/Postgres edge functions, and Cloudflare Workers as an LLM gateway. The matching pipeline parses the CV with an LLM, generates embeddings, retrieves candidates with pgvector, and reranks with an LLM. I implemented a credit-based monetization model with field-level paywalling (Postgres RLS + SECURITY DEFINER functions), Stripe payments, a realtime feed with polling fallback, and automated backups with per-user restore. The product was later discontinued.

snapnfund.title: SnapnFund
snapnfund.description: SnapnFund empowers shoppers to turn everyday purchases into donations by scanning receipts and directing funds to partner nonprofits. I led the full-stack delivery across the Flutter mobile app, the React web experience, and Firebase + ASP.NET services, owning architecture, state management, and release automation. Worked within a SCRUM team to integrate OCR, secure payment workflows, and responsive UI refinements that kept the donor flow fast and reliable.

dealerslash.title: DealerSlash
dealerslash.description: A vehicle buying and selling platform modernized from a legacy Java Spring API into a scalable ASP.NET Core backend. I drove the cloud migration to Google Cloud services and crafted a Flutter mobile experience with bespoke UI components, real-time inventory flows, and polished animations that made browsing and reserving vehicles feel premium.

followApp.title: Follow App
followApp.description: A mobile platform that connects faith communities to share discipleship courses, multimedia resources, and live teachings. I led the Flutter architecture and integrated NestJS + Firebase services for streaming, notifications, and progress tracking. Delivered leader dashboards, multilingual support, and accessible interfaces that reflect each congregation's voice.

timeforemost.title: TimeForemost
timeforemost.description: Built the Flutter mobile and Flutter Web frontend of an enterprise time-tracking platform as it grew from an internal tool into a full productivity monitoring and analytics service.

allInBiking.title: All In Biking
allInBiking.description: Led a team of 6 developers as de-facto tech lead on a cyclist-focused social network for Android and iOS, where riders share moments, enter competitions and connect with organizations. Built with Flutter on Firebase, Google Cloud and Neo4j for realtime data and resilient social features.

retarificador.title: Retarificador Alpha Brokers
retarificador.description: Six months as a frontend developer on an insurance re-rating web platform for Alpha Brokers: building and maintaining React screens, and shipping UI fixes and features alongside the rest of the team.

eduq.title: EduQ
eduq.description: Developed a mobile exercise-solving application built with Flutter, focused on preparing students for exams. The app provides an intuitive interface for solving practice exercises, progress tracking, and personalized study tools. Implemented scalable architecture, efficient state management, and a smooth user experience that facilitates continuous learning and practice.

manitas.title: Manitas
manitas.description: Currently developing a cross-platform application (web and mobile) to connect users with repair and handyman professionals in their local area. The platform enables searching, filtering, and contacting specialized technicians across various fields such as plumbing, electrical work, carpentry, and more. Implementing geolocation features to find nearby professionals, rating and review system, real-time chat, and appointment management. The mobile app is built with Flutter, while the web version will be developed with Next.js to deliver a smooth, scalable cross-platform experience.

chrona.title: Chrona
chrona.description: Currently developing a comprehensive appointment management system for a wide diversity of businesses, with future features on the way. The system enables different types of businesses to efficiently manage their appointments, clients, and schedules. Implementing the web platform with Next.js for the frontend and NestJS for the backend, providing a robust and scalable architecture. The Flutter mobile app is in development to complement the cross-platform experience and offer users complete appointment management from any device.

groceryChefPro.title: Grocery Chef Pro
groceryChefPro.description: A food-tracking app with AI-assisted shopping lists: users log their eating habits, build smart shopping lists and get recommendations based on their preferences and nutritional needs. The app was well advanced when the project was cancelled before launch.

openSource.name: hollow
openSource.problem: Hand-built skeleton loaders drift out of sync with the real UI. Every layout change means editing the placeholders twice — and they still never match.
openSource.solution: hollow captures the real RenderObject tree of your widgets through Dart AST analysis and a CLI, then generates the placeholders automatically so they always match the actual layout.
openSource.demoAlt: Animated demo of hollow generating skeleton loaders that match a real Flutter screen

tokendial.name: Tokendial
tokendial.tagline: Usage dials for AI coding assistants, native on macOS, Windows and Linux
tokendial.problem: You build with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot at once, and the only way to find out you are out of quota is when a tool stops answering. Each vendor meters differently, and none of them tells you before it happens.
tokendial.solution: A dial per tool at the edge of the screen, reading the session each tool already keeps on the machine. It warns before a window resets, tells you when an agent has been waiting on your answer, and stays out of the way the rest of the time.

features.dial: A dock of dials on any screen edge, expanding when the cursor reaches it and never stealing focus
features.readOnly: Read-only by design: it reads credentials where each tool stores them and writes nothing back
features.natives: Three native apps, Swift/AppKit, C#/WPF and C#/Avalonia, built from one shared JSON specification
features.install: Installs the tools you are missing through Homebrew, winget or npm, showing the exact command before it runs
features.alerts: Alerts at the thresholds you choose, before a window resets, and when a limit is spent
features.languages: Nine providers, six languages, right-to-left included

tokendial.shotAlt: The Tokendial settings window, with a dial and its usage for each provider
tokendial.specNote: All three apps read the same file. A provider added here appears on macOS, Windows and Linux at once, and the test suites on every side read these specs rather than copies.
